summary: The product being recalled is Chicken Caesar Wrap.  It is being recalled due to misbranding and an undeclared allergen, fish (anchovies), which is present in the Caesar dressing. Consumers are urged not to consume these products and should discard them or return them to the vending machine owners.
consumer_action: Consumers are urged not to consume these products and should discard them or return them to the vending machine owners.
